sources.title: Wan etal2020 Flabellophyton study, authors State Key Laboratory institutional report
sources.notes: Primary author institutional report and actual composite figure. Flabellophyton Ediacaran thallus has close unbranched radial filaments, narrow stalk and small basal holdfast; affinity unresolved. Model compressed fossil-style narrowfan rather than claiming living conic volume. Far-right reconstruction separated from fossil photos.
